{"pattern_id": "P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE", "decision": "APPLY", "rationale": "Add concurrency configuration to cancel superseded runs for the same workflow and branch/PR, as specified in the scenario contract. This implements the stale run cancellation pattern by using a concurrency group based on workflow and ref, with cancel-in-progress enabled.", "workflow_yaml": "name: CloudTune controlled scenario
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - ct-scenario/**
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  probe:
    name: probe
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Controlled workload
      shell: bash
      run: 'sleep 90

        printf "revision completed\n"

        '"}
